status: exact ordinary-Mobius feature Gram and pre-square vector Vaughan reduction with one open signed gate

rows.statement: For each fixed 0<alpha<1, Lemma 11.22Y gives R_alpha<infinity iff sum_(K dyadic)K^(-2-alpha)H_K<infinity.
rows.proof_boundary: This artifact begins from the independently checked ordinary-Mobius anchored criterion.
The future anchor is retained exactly rather than bounded or discarded.

rows.statement: Every coefficient b_K(n)=((2K)/n)^s(4K-n)/(2K) in beta_K lies in [0,1].
rows.proof_boundary: Bounded coefficients do not imply cancellation of beta_K.

rows.statement: Let I_K={n:K<n<4K}; the feature vectors have K real coordinates indexed by 1<=t<=K.
rows.proof_boundary: All arithmetic coefficients now lie in one compact three-to-one interval.

rows.statement: Set a_(K,t)(K+i)=1_(t<=i) for 1<=i<K and a_(K,t)(n)=b_K(n) for 2K<=n<4K.
rows.proof_boundary: The current block is a nested suffix feature and the future anchor is the constant vector direction.
The endpoint t=K contains beta_K and an empty current suffix.
The open scalar suffix family is one finite-dimensional Hilbert norm.
This is an equivalent RH-strength criterion for every fixed positive alpha in a cofinal sequence.
The kernel is a Gram kernel and is therefore positive semidefinite.

rows.statement: For n=K+i and m=K+j with 1<=i,j<K, L_K(n,m)=min(i,j).
rows.proof_boundary: Count the coordinates t lying below both suffix endpoints.
The future anchor occupies the constant vector direction.
The future-future block has rank one.
After multiplying by K^(-2-alpha), every pair weight is at most K^(-1-alpha).
The positive norm still contains a genuinely signed off-diagonal Mobius form.
This is the complete Gram diagonal, including the future anchor.
The bound is an exact finite sum-of-squares envelope.
The last inequality holds for every integer K>=1.
The diagonal is closed for each fixed alpha>0, not at alpha=0.

rows.statement: Let C_(vec,K)=sum_(n<m; n,m in I_K)mu(n)mu(m)L_K(n,m); then H_K=Delta_K+2C_(vec,K).
rows.proof_boundary: No absolute values are introduced in the correlation sum.
The summable diagonal and nonnegative partial energy make the upper boundedness criterion exact.

rows.statement: The feature envelope gives ||sum_n mu(n)a_K(n)||_2=O(K^(3/2)) and H_K=O(K^3), hence weighted scale O(K^(1-alpha)).
rows.proof_boundary: Coefficientwise or rowwise absolute values lose one full power relative to the summable K^(-alpha) calibration.

rows.statement: Split I_K into X<n<=2X for X=K and X=2K; for each X set U_X=V_X=floor(sqrt(X)), with a zero feature at n=4K.
rows.proof_boundary: Both pieces now have the standard finite Vaughan interval shape.
These are the finite Type I coefficients in Green-Tao's Vaughan identity.
These are the finite Type II divisor coefficients.
The inner sum is a deterministic vector and contains no collapsed Mertens target.
The bilinear Mobius factor is retained inside the vector sum.

rows.statement: Green-Tao's finite Vaughan identity applied componentwise gives sum_(X<n<=2X)mu(n)a_K(n)=-V_(I,K,X)+V_(II,K,X).
rows.proof_boundary: Finite-dimensional componentwise use requires no vector-valued extension theorem.
The signed Type I/II cancellation is preserved before taking a norm.
This is a noncircular vector-valued arithmetic handoff with bounded deterministic features.

rows.statement: Bounds for ||V_(I,K)||_2 and ||V_(II,K)||_2 separately are sufficient only if they retain the required power.
rows.proof_boundary: They are not equivalent to the signed-difference criterion and may erase its decisive cancellation.

rows.statement: Even a uniform coordinate estimate B_(K,t)=o(K) yields only H_K=o(K^3).
rows.proof_boundary: The target needs average-square cancellation at essentially K^2 scale, not merely sublinear cancellation per suffix.

rows.statement: Mobius and arbitrary finite-vector checks reproduce the features, explicit Gram blocks, diagonal bound, signed expansion, and both interval Vaughan vectors.
rows.proof_boundary: Finite validation proves the identities only and supplies no asymptotic Mobius estimate.

rows.statement: Matomaki-Shao-Tao-Teravainen give H*log^(-A)X cancellation for Mobius in every interval when H>=X^(5/8+epsilon).
rows.proof_boundary: Squaring this scalar bound over O(K) long suffix endpoints still gives the K^3*log^(-2A) scale; the theorem does not state the required K^(2+epsilon) vector square estimate.

rows.statement: Prove the vector Vaughan criterion in row 29 for every member of one fixed cofinal sequence alpha_j->0 without assuming RH.
rows.proof_boundary: No vector Type I/II power gain, full Burnol bound, RH, PF-infinity, or Lambda<=0 conclusion is supplied here.
